title: Find another recoverable terminal-phase plateau
hypothesis: At least one unscanned task has a terminal-geometry bottleneck that expert takeover can complete from learner states but fixed-budget parameter search cannot.

prediction.against: Task-matched scripted expert on the same 30 confirmation cases
prediction.rationale: At least one task must exhibit a learner–expert gap of 0.90 or more, with zero learner successes, to justify another trace-repair testbed rather than merely another difficult task.

protocol.command: gpu run -- python scripts/research.py recoverable-plateau-scan --config config/two_lane_search_v2.yaml --tasks shelf-place-v2,basketball-v2,soccer-v2 --seeds 3810,3811,3812,3813,3814,3815,3816,3817,3818 --expert-cases 30 --expert-gate 0.9 --structures-per-task 1 --search-candidates 24 --probe-cases 5 --confirmation-cases 30 --handoffs-per-plateau 5 --bc-steps 0 --max-repair-per-candidate 1 --model gpt-6.1-sol --reasoning-effort high --temperature 1 --out-dir logs/research/recoverable_plateau_scan
code_changes: scripts/research.py: compose the existing expert-calibration, numerical-search and learner-to-expert-handoff paths into this subcommand. Unlike D-026, gate tasks independently rather than aborting the whole scan; unlike D-029, diagnose recoverability before requesting any trace-conditioned edit.

For each expert-qualified task, generate exactly one structure and search 24 candidates on five probe cases. Any probe success rejects plateau status. Otherwise confirm the probe-selected winner on development cases 10-39; any confirmation success also rejects plateau status. No replacement structure or repair edit.

For each confirmed plateau, restore five predeclared failed learner states at the attempted terminal-phase transition and measure expert continuation success and phase occupancy. Require at least three successful takeovers to label it recoverable. Obtain per-idea spend approval first; freeze manifests and resolved settings in the out-dir. Maximum budget is 90 expert + 360 search + 90 confirmation + 15 continuation episodes; early gates reduce this.

falsified_by: Every expert-qualified task produces a learner success during search or confirmation, or every confirmed zero-success learner has fewer than three successful expert takeovers out of five. If no expert qualifies, the plateau question is inconclusive; the missing measurement is a reliable expert's success on those tasks.
